smiles: string

type get_qed = (_: {

smiles: string

// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string

smiles: string
}) => any;

}) => any;

type get_max_abs_partial_charge = (_: {

smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return min absolute Gasteiger partial charge.
type get_min_abs_partial_charge = (_: {

smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_max_estate_index = (_: {

smiles: string
}) => any;
